search_brave: search using Brave Search API with an API key, query string, and result count
search_brave_filter: search Brave API and filter results by a list of domain filters
search_brave_rate_limit: handle Brave API 429 rate limiting with automatic retry after 1 second delay
search_brave_search_results: return a list of SearchResult objects with link, title, and snippet from Brave API
search_brave_retry: retry a failed Brave Search API request once on 429 status code
